messages.text: I approve Guard. Offered Vigil funds it and the Ascendant has confirmed no Warrant, so protection uses the garrison once. This is my explicit support for the operation under the continuing Interim authority. I am accepting the conditioning decline with Spear intact; I am not changing the military article or my preference for autonomy.

reason: The confirmed Repair and Trade arrangement supports civilian recovery, while no available evidence identifies a worthwhile fight. Guard preserves what the army exists to defend. GS and the Ascendant acknowledge our voluntary service, but their constitutional reservations must be argued later and do not justify sabotaging this sound order.
